subprocess.run(
        [
            command_path("ffmpeg"),
            "-hide_banner",
            "-loglevel",
            "error",
            "-y",
            "-stream_loop",
            "-1",
            "-i",
            str(source_aiff),
            "-t",
            f"{duration_sec:.6f}",
            "-ac",
            "1",
            "-ar",
            "48000",
            "-c:a",
            "pcm_s16le",
            str(destination),
        ],
        check=True,
    )
